content:
The analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in panel-level margins and aggregate annual totals.
The verifier reported two major failures in /tests/test_outputs.py. In test_rows_and_order, a panel margin mismatch occurred where close(369.2, 6276.4) returned False. In test_totals_and_decision, the calculated total_annual_margin_14_day_usd was 26185.96, which failed to match the expected 1090.76. While the environment setup and 3 other tests passed, the core cost-benefit logic is producing incorrect financial outputs.
